anchors.note: r=0.88, 0.96 and 0.98 (df=3) are in the Figure 2 footnotes. The appraisal was rechecked: the plotted points reproduce these r values (editors' reading −0.88, 0.97, 0.98) and average about +13% (Timed Gait), −13% (Symbol Digit) and −12% (delayed recall), while Volkow et al. (2001b, pp. 9415–9416) report the same five people's Timed Gait improving from 10.0 to 8.6 s and delayed recall from 11.6 to 12.8 words. No sign convention makes the plotted directions agree with the abstract and the plotted means agree with the companion paper. The attribution to a second reader in the extracted text is a provenance remark, not source data.
